'''Mikaster III''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Mikaster system/Legends|Mikaster system]], a part of the [[Mikaster sector/Legends|Mikaster sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] fought a [[Battle of Mikaster III|battle]] on Mikaster III. During the engagement, Confederate [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra combat tri-droids]] picked their way through rubble, deploying a [[nanovirus]]-based [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] that shrouded them in veils of [[Acid/Legends|acidic]] vapor and targeted the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], to whom the [[Weapon/Legends|weapon]] was [[Death/Legends|lethal]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mikaster III was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the Mikaster [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Mikaster III, in grid square N-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
